name: Bird Merged Database
definition: One SQLite file merging nine independent BIRD source databases; each source keeps its own tables, identifier space and business vocabulary, and no cross-source join is meaningful.

name: California School
definition: A public K-12 school record identified by a 14-digit CDS code.

name: School District
definition: A school district that operates schools and carries a district type.

name: County
definition: California county name used to group schools.

name: Free and Reduced Price Meal Record
definition: Per-school, per-academic-year free and reduced-price meal (FRPM) enrollment statistics.

name: SAT Score Record
definition: SAT aggregate scores for a school or district; rtype D rows are district aggregates, rtype S rows are school rows.

name: District Type
definition: District type code with its description, e.g. 52 Elementary School District, 54 Unified School District.

name: School Status
definition: Lifecycle status of a school record: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending.

name: Charter School Indicator
definition: Whether a school is a charter school; 1 = charter, 0 = non-chartered.

name: Virtual Instruction Status
definition: Virtual instruction flag: F = fully/exclusively virtual (no physical building), P = partial, N = not virtual.

name: Charter Funding Type
definition: Funding model of a school: Directly funded, Locally funded, Not in CS funding model; populated mainly for charter schools.

name: K-12 Enrollment
definition: Number of students enrolled in grades K-12.

name: K-12 Free Meal Count
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals.

name: K-12 Free Meal Rate
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals (cl0020 / cl0019).
aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate

name: K-12 FRPM Count
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
aliases: free or reduced price meal count

name: K-12 FRPM Rate
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals (cl0022 / cl0019).

name: Ages 5-17 Enrollment
definition: Number of students aged 5-17 enrolled.

name: Ages 5-17 FRPM Count
definition: Number of students aged 5-17 eligible for free or reduced-price meals.

name: K-12 versus Ages 5-17 Enrollment Gap
definition: Difference between K-12 enrollment and ages 5-17 enrollment.
scope: california_schools, derived from tb001.cl0019 and cl0024

name: Average SAT Reading Score
definition: Average SAT reading score for the record.

name: Average SAT Math Score
definition: Average SAT math score for the record.

name: Average SAT Writing Score
definition: Average SAT writing score for the record.

name: Average of Average Math Scores
definition: Average taken over a set of records of their average math scores: sum of average math divided by number of records.

name: School Street Address
definition: Postal/mailing street address of a school; the physical and mailing street columns are synonyms.

name: School Phone Number
definition: Telephone / communication number of a school.

name: Magic Card
definition: A single Magic: The Gathering card printing identified by cl0089.

name: Card Set
definition: An expansion/core set that groups card printings.

name: Card Artist
definition: Illustrator credited on a card.

name: Foreign-Language Card Printing
definition: A card printing with translated name, text or type line in a non-English language.

name: Card Format Legality
definition: Legality of a card in a play format.

name: Card Ruling
definition: Official ruling text issued for a card on a date.

name: Set Name Translation
definition: Translated name of a card set in a given language.

name: Card Language
definition: Language of a card printing or set translation (16 values, inc. Chinese Simplified, German, Italian).

name: Play Format
definition: Format a legality record refers to, e.g. commander, modern, legacy, duel.

name: Legality Status
definition: Legal, Banned or Restricted status of a card in a format.

name: Card Border Color
definition: Border colour of the printing: black, white, silver, gold, borderless.

name: Card Color
definition: Colour identity letters of a card (W, U, B, R, G combinations).

name: Card Type
definition: Primary card type(s) such as Creature, Instant, Land, Artifact.

name: Card Subtype
definition: Comma-separated subtypes of a card (e.g. Human,Cleric).

name: Card Supertype
definition: Comma-separated supertypes of a card (Legendary, Basic, Snow, World).

name: Card Frame Style
definition: Frame version/era of the printing (1993, 1997, 2003, 2015).

name: Promotional Printing Flag
definition: Whether the printing is a promotional printing; 1 = promo.

name: Textless Card Flag
definition: Whether the card printing has no text box; 0 = no text box.
aliases: do not have a text box

name: Card Power
definition: Power value of a creature card; '*' denotes infinite power and NULL denotes unknown power.

name: Base Set Size
definition: Base number of cards in a set.

name: Foreign-Only Set Flag
definition: Whether a set was printed only outside the United States; 1 = foreign only.
aliases: only available outside the United States

name: Card Share Percentage
definition: Percentage of a card population satisfying a condition: conditioned count divided by total count times 100.

name: Debit Card Customer
definition: A customer holding a debit card, with segment and payment currency.

name: Gas Station
definition: A fuel station with chain, country and station segment.

name: Product
definition: A product category sold at a station, with a description.

name: Debit Card Transaction
definition: A single purchase at a gas station by a customer at a date and time.

name: Monthly Gas Consumption
definition: Gas consumption for a customer in a year-month.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Business segment of a customer: SME, LAM, KAM.

name: Payment Currency
definition: Currency a customer pays in: EUR or CZK.

name: Country Code
definition: Country of a gas station: CZE (Czech Republic) or SVK (Slovakia).

name: Year-Month
definition: Six-character period identifier YYYYMM; first four characters are the year, last two the month.

name: Transaction Item Quantity
definition: Number of items in a transaction; total price divided by this gives price per item.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: Total price paid in a transaction.

name: Average Price per Item
definition: Sum of transaction amounts divided by sum of item quantities.

name: Gas Consumption Value
definition: Consumption quantity recorded per customer per month.

name: Bank Account
definition: A bank account with an opening district and statement frequency.

name: Client
definition: A bank client with gender, birth date and home district.

name: Account Disposition
definition: Link between a client and an account with a disposition type (OWNER / DISPONENT).

name: Bank District
definition: Czech district with region, inhabitants, average salary, unemployment and crime statistics.

name: Loan Contract
definition: A loan contract of an account with amount, duration, payments and status.

name: Account Transaction
definition: A debit/credit/withdrawal movement on an account.

name: Credit Card
definition: A credit card issued for a disposition, with card type.

name: Client Gender
definition: Gender of a client: F = female, M = male.

name: District Region
definition: Region name grouping districts (e.g. south Bohemia, Prague).

name: Loan Status
definition: Contract status: A = finished OK, B = finished not paid, C = running OK, D = running in debt.

name: Disposition Type
definition: Role of a client on an account: OWNER or DISPONENT.

name: Credit Card Type
definition: Credit card tier: gold, classic or junior.

name: Transaction Type
definition: Movement direction: PRIJEM (credit), VYDAJ (debit), VYBER (withdrawal).

name: Transaction Operation
definition: Detailed operation code of a transaction; VYBER KARTOU means credit card withdrawal.

name: District Average Salary
definition: Average salary reported for a district.

name: Unemployment Rate 1995
definition: District unemployment rate in 1995.

name: Unemployment Rate 1996
definition: District unemployment rate in 1996.

name: Crimes Committed 1995
definition: Number of crimes committed in a district in 1995.

name: District Inhabitants
definition: Number of inhabitants of a district.

name: Unemployment Rate Increment
definition: Percentage change from the 1995 to the 1996 unemployment rate: (rate_1996 - rate_1995) / rate_1995 * 100.
scope: financial, derived from tb019.cl0220 and cl0221

name: Loan Amount
definition: Amount borrowed under a loan contract.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: Monetary amount of an account transaction.

name: Statement Frequency
definition: Account statement issuance frequency; POPLATEK PO OBRATU means issuance after each transaction.

name: F1 Circuit
definition: A racing circuit with location, country and coordinates.

name: F1 Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 team/constructor with nationality and website.

name: F1 Driver
definition: A driver with forename, surname, date of birth, nationality and reference name.

name: F1 Season
definition: A championship year.

name: F1 Race
definition: A Grand Prix event in a season, held at a circuit on a date.

name: Race Result
definition: One driver's result in one race: grid, finishing position, points, time and status.

name: Lap Time
definition: Lap-by-lap timing for a driver in a race.

name: Pit Stop
definition: A pit stop of a driver in a race with duration.

name: Qualifying Session
definition: Qualifying result with Q1, Q2 and Q3 times.

name: Result Status
definition: Reason/category of a race result, e.g. Finished, Accident, Collision, Disqualified.

name: Nationality
definition: Nationality of a driver or constructor (free text, not a country table).

name: Driver Age
definition: Age computed from date of birth; a larger birth date means a younger person.

name: Championship Points
definition: Points scored by a driver or constructor in a race or standings snapshot.

name: Finish Time
definition: Result time value; the champion shows HH:MM:SS.mmm while others show a '+gap' string.

name: Pit Stop Duration
definition: Duration of a single pit stop in seconds.

name: Average Pit Stop Duration
definition: Average pit stop duration for a driver: sum of durations divided by count of stops.

name: Fastest Lap Speed
definition: Speed of the driver's fastest lap in a result.

name: Grid / Track Position
definition: Starting grid slot of a driver in a race.

name: Circuit Location Coordinates
definition: Latitude and longitude pair locating a circuit.

name: Student Club Event
definition: An event run by the student club with name, date, type, location and status.

name: Club Member
definition: A student club member with name, email, position, t-shirt size and phone.

name: Academic Major
definition: A major with its department and college.

name: Zip Code Area
definition: A zip code with its city, county and state.

name: Event Budget Line
definition: A budget line for an event and category, with amount, spent and remaining values.

name: Expense
definition: An expense incurred for a budget line, with description, date and cost.

name: Event Attendance
definition: Association of a member with an event they attended.

name: Event Status
definition: Event status: Open, Planning or Closed.

name: Budget Status
definition: Budget line status: Open, Planning or Closed.

name: Academic Department
definition: Department that owns a major.

name: Member Position
definition: Club position of a member, e.g. President, Vice President, Member, Inactive.

name: Budget Category
definition: Spending category of a budget line, e.g. Advertisement, Food, Speaker Gifts, Parking.

name: Budget Amount
definition: Allocated budget amount of a budget line.

name: Budget Spent
definition: Amount spent against a budget line.

name: Budget Remaining
definition: Budget remaining for a line; a negative value means the budget was exceeded.

name: Expense Cost
definition: Monetary cost of an expense.

name: Spend-to-Budget Ratio
definition: Budget spent divided by budget amount for a budget line.
scope: student_club, derived from tb040.cl0308 and cl0310

name: Attendance Count
definition: Number of members recorded as attending an event.

name: Superhero
definition: A superhero with name, full name, gender, physical attributes and demographic references.

name: Superhero Attribute
definition: Named attribute dimension: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat.

name: Superpower
definition: A named superpower such as Super Strength.

name: Hero Attribute Value Record
definition: Value of one attribute for one superhero.

name: Hero Superpower Record
definition: Association of a superhero with one superpower.

name: Comic Publisher
definition: Publisher of a superhero, e.g. Marvel Comics, DC Comics, Dark Horse Comics.

name: Superhero Gender
definition: Gender of a superhero: 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = N/A.

name: Alignment
definition: Moral alignment: Good, Bad, Neutral, N/A; Bad corresponds to villains.

name: Superhero Height
definition: Height in centimetres.

name: Superhero Weight
definition: Weight in kilograms.

name: Attribute Value
definition: Numeric value of a superhero attribute (0-100 scale).

name: Thrombosis Patient
definition: A patient with sex, birth date, admission dates and diagnosis.

name: Medical Examination
definition: A hospital examination visit recording symptoms, diagnosis and thrombosis severity.

name: Laboratory Test
definition: A laboratory measurement record for a patient on a date with many lab analytes.

name: Patient Sex
definition: Sex of a patient: F = female, M = male, empty = unknown.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Diagnosis code/text such as SLE, RA, APS, PSS, MCTD.

name: Thrombosis Severity
definition: Degree of thrombosis: 0 = none, 1 = most severe, 2 = severe, 3 = mild.

name: Symptoms
definition: Symptoms observed during an examination.

name: Patient Age
definition: Age computed as current year minus birth year; a larger birth date means a younger person.

name: LDH
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase value from a lab test; values above 500 are beyond normal range.

name: Uric Acid
definition: Uric acid concentration; normal upper bound depends on sex (8.0 male, 6.5 female).

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol lab value.

name: Red Blood Cell Count
definition: Red blood cell count; values below 3.5 are considered lower than normal.

name: Hematocrit
definition: Hematocrit level; values at or above 52 exceed the normal range.

name: Prothrombin Time
definition: Prothrombin time (PT); values at or above 14 are abnormal.

name: Immunoglobulin A
definition: IgA level; 80-500 is the normal range.

name: Anti-Cardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anti-cardiolipin antibody (aCL) concentration value.

name: Anti-Sm Antibody
definition: Anti-Sm antibody result; negative values '-' and '0' and mixed '+-' indicate normal.

name: Toxicology Molecule
definition: A molecule candidate with an identifier TRnnn and a carcinogenic label.

name: Molecule Atom
definition: An atom occurrence inside a molecule, identified as <molecule>_<atom number>.

name: Chemical Bond
definition: A bond inside a molecule identified by the two atom numbers joined to the molecule id.

name: Connected Atom Pair
definition: Ordered pair of atoms connected by a bond; atoms absent here have no bonds.

name: Chemical Element
definition: Element symbol of an atom, e.g. c, h, o, n, cl.

name: Bond Type
definition: Bond order: '-' single, '=' double, '#' triple.

name: Carcinogenic Label
definition: Carcinogenicity of a molecule: '+' = carcinogenic, '-' = non-carcinogenic.
